layers.label: Under the Hood
layers.title: 10 Intelligence Layers
layers.subtitle: Every signal passes through 10 independent analysis layers before it reaches your wallet. Each layer adds context, filters noise, and increases conviction. No other system comes close.

0.title: QuantGuild Technical Analysis
0.short: 13 indicators, 8 pattern detectors scanning every 10 seconds.
0.detail: The mathematical core. Calculates RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, EMA crossovers, ATR, ADX, and volume ratios on 100 candles of history. Detects 8 patterns: Dip Buy, Deep Value Crash, Bollinger Squeeze, RSI Oversold, MACD Cross, EMA Cross, Volume Spike, and Momentum Gainer.

1.title: Multi-Timeframe Confirmation
1.short: 15-minute signals verified against 1h, 4h, and daily trends.
1.detail: A 15-minute breakout means nothing if the hourly and 4-hour charts disagree. Our HTF veto system requires EMA alignment across multiple timeframes. If 1h and 4h are both bearish, BUY signals are blocked — preventing false breakout trades.

2.title: Smart Dip Hunter Strategy
2.short: Backtested 80-100% win rate on mean-reversion patterns.
2.detail: Our data shows dip/value patterns (DIP_BUY, DEEP_VALUE_CRASH, BOLLINGER_SQUEEZE) have 80-100% win rates vs 0-25% for trend-following signals. Smart Dip Hunter enforces this: every signal MUST contain a value pattern. Pure trend signals are rejected.

3.title: GainerScanner
3.short: Top movers get a +10% confidence boost when aligned with signals.
3.detail: Every 15 minutes, we rank all symbols by 1h, 4h, and 24h price change. When a technical signal aligns with a top mover (3%+ in 1 hour), confidence jumps +10%. This prevents trading against the tape.

4.title: CoinMarketCap Macro Intelligence
4.short: Fear & Greed index, BTC dominance, market cap filters.
4.detail: Global macro context from CoinMarketCap: Fear & Greed adjustments (+8% in extreme fear for deep value, -10% in extreme greed), BTC dominance penalty for altcoins, market cap rank filter (top 500 only), FDV/MC dilution filter (reject >4x ratio), and global regime override on market crash.

5.title: Telegram Signal Consensus
5.detail: Real-time monitoring of professional Telegram signal channels using Telethon. Multi-format parser handles Cornix, simple text, and emoji signals. When 2-3 channels agree on the same symbol, confidence increases +8-12%. Built-in deduplication prevents double-counting.

6.title: X/Twitter Sentiment Analysis
6.short: Auto-rejects signals during hack, exploit, or rug events.
6.detail: Scans X/Twitter for security alerts: hack, exploit, rug pull, delist, scam, lawsuit. If detected for a symbol, the BUY signal is instantly rejected. Bullish sentiment gives +5-8% boost, bearish sentiment applies -5% penalty.

7.title: News RSS Sentiment
7.short: Cointelegraph and CoinDesk sentiment analysis every 15 minutes.
7.detail: Parses RSS feeds from major crypto news outlets. Keyword-based sentiment scoring detects positive (adoption, surge, bullish) and negative (ban, crash, exploit) context per symbol. Results cached in Redis with 1-hour TTL.

8.title: Grok AI Validation
8.short: 3 specialized AI prompts: crash specialist, dip specialist, trend analyst.
8.detail: Every signal gets a second opinion from Grok-4.1 with high-effort reasoning. Three specialized prompt modes: Deep Value Crash (crash-buying specialist), Dip Buy (mean-reversion specialist that expects bearish HTF), and Trend Following (standard risk analyst). Confidence is blended: 60% technical + 40% AI. Fail-closed: if AI is unavailable, the signal is rejected.

9.title: Expected Value (EV) Model
9.short: Rejects patterns with historically negative profitability.
9.detail: Daily calibration analyzes all closed trades over 30 days. Computes per-pattern EV: win rate, average win/loss, total expected value. Patterns with negative EV are automatically blocked. Self-improving: as more trades complete, the model becomes more accurate.

risk_section.label: Capital Protection
risk_section.title: 5-Layer Risk Architecture
risk_section.subtitle: Most bots blow up accounts. We built 5 independent risk layers that protect your capital even when markets go haywire.

0.title: Circuit Breakers
0.description: 5 automatic circuit breakers: daily loss limit (5%), weekly loss limit (10%), consecutive loss protection (5+ losses), ATR volatility pause, and per-symbol cooldowns. Trading stops automatically when limits are hit.

1.title: 12 Sequential Quality Filters
1.description: Every signal passes through 12 filters in order: confidence threshold, risk/reward ratio, order value, daily limits, position count, spread check, EV model, dip focus validation, HTF veto, sentiment check, AI validation, and capital allocation.

2.title: 5-Way Position Exit System
2.description: Take-profit (ATR-based), stop-loss (native exchange order), trailing stop (activates at +3%), stagnation timeout (8 hours), and dust prevention (sells before hitting minimum order value).

3.title: Kelly Criterion Position Sizing
3.description: Position sizes are calculated using the Kelly Criterion at 0.5x (half-Kelly for stability). No single trade risks more than 35% of capital. Sizes adapt based on pattern win rate and average win/loss ratio.

4.title: Market Regime Detection
4.description: Classifies market as Trending, Ranging, or Volatile using ADX and ATR expansion. Capital allocation shifts automatically: volatile markets increase reserve to 30%, protect capital first.
